subject: Saturday cleanup timing
text:
We are holding the community cleanup on Saturday, not next Friday. Meet at the library entrance at nine, not nine-thirty, because the supplies have to be loaded first. Bring gloves and wear closed shoes. The grant summary is still missing the vendor quotes, so please add them by Thursday night. That piece is the only unfinished task I need from you before the meeting with the facilities team. If your shift changes, tell me early enough so I can reorganize the volunteers. Keep the reply short. Rain plan: back porch. Bring a jacket. Arrive early. Bring water.

Thanks,
